links.outcome: Reading grade level of AAOS Spanish patient education materials versus recommended sixth grade
links.effect: None of 77 materials met the recommended sixth-grade level or below by both formulas; 32% (25 of 77) were written at a seventh- to eighth-grade level.
links.quote: Before AI adaptations, none of the 77 education materials met the recommended reading level of sixth grade or below according to both readability formulas.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-adapted Spanish patient education materials versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: After a single simplification attempt, only 23% (18) and 16% (12) of AI adaptations were at or below sixth grade per Fernández-Huerta and SOL; 52% rated accurate, 56% useful.
links.quote: Only 23% (18) and 16% (12) of the AI adaptations were written at or below the recommended sixth-grade level per the Fernández-Huerta and SOL grade levels, respectively.

links.outcome: Surgeon-rated accuracy of AI-adapted Spanish education materials versus originals
links.effect: Only 52% (40) of AI adaptations were rated accurate and 56% (43) useful by the evaluating orthopaedic surgeons.
links.quote: Of the AI adaptations, 52% (40) were rated as accurate and 56% (43) were rated as useful for patient education by the evaluating orthopaedic surgeons.
